sloka: तेन मामद्य संयुक्तं रथस्थमिह संयुगे।प्रतीयात् को ऽद्य मामाजौ साक्षादपि पुरन्दरः ।। ६.९३.३१ ।।
transliteration: tena māmadya saṁyuktaṁ rathasthamiha saṁyuge।pratīyāt ko 'dya māmājau sākṣādapi purandaraḥ ।। 6.93.31 ।।

translations.english: 'Today if I, with that shield mounted the chariot go for battle, who can dare to withstand me openly? Even Indra can't'.
